patch_description: This crossover keeps the structure of the current program (deterministic multi-seed optimization returning a (13,2) array, rescaled so the convex hull has unit area) but replaces the slow Python triple loop and the box-barrier with a fully vectorized, scale-invariant formulation. Key improvements: (1) all 286 triangle areas and their gradients are computed with precomputed index arrays and `np.add.at` scatter (no Python loops); (2) the objective is the actual metric, min_area/hull_area, via a softmin gradient on triangle areas combined with a `-∇log(hull_area)` term, which is affine/scale invariant so no boundary barriers are needed; (3) multiple deterministic initializations (regular 13-gon, 3-fold symmetric, random disk points) with more iterations become affordable; (4) a final exact hill-climb on single-point perturbations polishes the best configuration. This combines the correctness of the gradient approach from the current program with far more optimization within the same time budget, which should substantially raise min_area_normalized and the combined score.
